pretreatments.description: Concentrated phosphoric acid pretreatment was performed on different parts of spruce tree. One g of dry substrate was weighed into 50 mL centrifuge tube, mixed with 8 mL of phosphoric acid (83 ~ 85.9 %), placed in the water bath at 50 °C for 50 min. Acetone was added and centrifuged, then washing with distilled water was performed. Solids were dried in an oven at 40 °C after washing. The pretreatment liquor and solids were stored in sealable plastic bags.

Organosolv pretreatment was carried out using ethanol (75 % v/v) at 150 °C for 30 min with sulfuric acid catalyst (1 % w/w based on dry weight of substrate). The substrate (20 g) was mixed with 160 mL of 75 % ethanol solution, heated in the reactor at 150 °C for 30 min, and placed in an ice bath. Liquid and solid phases were separated, solids washed with distilled water, then dried at 40 °C. Pretreatment yields and storage were calculated.

Dilute acid pretreatment was carried out according to the optimum conditions reported by Safari et al. [28] for softwood pine. 20 g of substrate based on dry weight was mixed with 200 g of 0.5 % w/w sulfuric acid (solid to liquid ratio 1:10). The mixture was transferred to a 500 mL reactor, placed in an oil bath, the bath temperature set at 140 °C for 5 min. Liquid and solid phases were separated, solids washed with distilled water to be neutralized, then dried at 40 °C in an oven and stored at room temperature.
